info.name: Task 2 - Insert Orders from File
info.description: POST /api/integration/insertOrders takes no body: it reads a CSV from the input folder. Postman cannot place files on disk, so before each request copy the fixture named in the request description into C:/mule-training/input/ (as orders.csv unless stated), send the request, then verify the DB tables and the input/output/error folders. Reset the tables between cases (see task2-test-plan.md). Run requests one at a time.

request.description:
**Stage:** copy `fixtures/tc01_sample.csv` to `C:/mule-training/input/orders.csv`

**Expected HTTP:** 200

**Verify manually:** 3 rows in `customer_orders` (AES45678, `AES4 5679`, AES45680); totals 1200 / 2500 / 5100 as numbers; timestamps ISO 8601 (2021-12-02T23:02:00, T09:11:00, T18:02:00); 0 rows in `order_errors`; file moved to `output/`; `file_audit_log` = SUCCESS

**Stage:** copy `fixtures/tc02_crlf.csv` to `C:/mule-training/input/orders.csv`

**Expected HTTP:** 200

**Verify manually:** 3 rows (CRL0001-0003); `order_total` stored as 1200 / 2500 / 5100 with no trailing carriage return; file in `output/`; SUCCESS

**Stage:** copy `fixtures/tc03_bulk_1000.csv` to `C:/mule-training/input/orders.csv`

**Expected HTTP:** 200

**Verify manually:** 1000 rows (BULK0001-BULK1000); 0 in `order_errors`; file in `output/`; exactly one SUCCESS audit row

item.name: TC04 - Whitespace trimmed on all string fields

request.description:
**Stage:** copy `fixtures/tc04_trim.csv` to `C:/mule-training/input/orders.csv`

**Expected HTTP:** 200

**Verify manually:** 3 rows: `WSP0001`, `WSP0002`, `WSP 0003`; leading/trailing spaces and tabs removed from every field; the internal space in `WSP 0003` is kept; totals 1200 / 2500 / 5100 numeric; file in `output/`

item.name: TC05 - Timestamps converted to ISO 8601 (AM/PM edges)

request.description:
**Stage:** copy `fixtures/tc05_timestamps.csv` to `C:/mule-training/input/orders.csv`

**Expected HTTP:** 200

**Verify manually:** 6 rows (TS0001-TS0006): 2021-12-02T00:00:00 (12:00 AM), 2021-12-02T12:00:00 (12:00 PM), 2021-12-02T23:59:59, 2021-12-02T01:05:00, 2021-12-31T23:00:00, 2024-02-29T08:30:00. Assumes MM/dd/yyyy - TS0005 (12/31) only parses month-first

**Stage:** copy `fixtures/tc06_totals.csv` to `C:/mule-training/input/orders.csv`

**Expected HTTP:** 200

**Verify manually:** 5 rows (TOT0001-TOT0005); totals stored numerically: 1200, 1200.50, 0, 99999999.99, 2500.75 (last one had surrounding spaces); decimals not rounded or truncated

item.name: TC07 - Quoted comma, unicode, quote characters

request.description:
**Stage:** copy `fixtures/tc07_special_chars.csv` to `C:/mule-training/input/orders.csv`

**Expected HTTP:** 200

**Verify manually:** 4 rows stored literally: embedded comma kept in `Paid, pending`; Chinese text intact; doubled quotes unescaped to `Cancelled "by user"`; the `' OR '1'='1` value stored as plain text. A SQL error here means the insert builds SQL by concatenation (use parameters). Run on a local DB only

item.name: TC08 - One bad record does not stop the loop

request.description:
**Stage:** copy `fixtures/tc08_partial_failure.csv` to `C:/mule-training/input/orders.csv`

**Expected HTTP:** 200

**Verify manually:** 3 rows inserted (PRT0001, PRT0003, PRT0005); 2 rows in `order_errors` (PRT0002: `order_status` is 26 chars but the column is varchar(20); PRT0004: `order_total` 99999999999 is out of range for decimal(10,2)); file in `output/`; SUCCESS

item.name: TC08B - Failed row whose user_id is too long for order_errors

request.description:
**Stage:** copy `fixtures/tc08b_long_user_id.csv` to `C:/mule-training/input/orders.csv`

**Expected HTTP:** 200

**Verify manually:** The 300-char `user_id` fails the insert AND would fail the `order_errors` insert (varchar(20)) unless truncated. Expect LUI0001 and LUI0003 inserted; 1 row in `order_errors` with `user_id` cut to 20 chars (or NULL) and the full error in `error_message`; the loop finishes; file in `output/`; SUCCESS

item.name: TC09 - [Assumed] All records fail - still 200 per spec

request.description:
**Stage:** copy `fixtures/tc09_all_fail.csv` to `C:/mule-training/input/orders.csv`

**Expected HTTP:** 200

**Verify manually:** 0 rows in `customer_orders`; 3 rows in `order_errors` (ALF0001-0003, status too long); file in `output/`; SUCCESS (literal reading of steps 5-8) - confirm this is intended

exec:
pm.test("Status is one of [200, 400]", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200, 400]));
pm.test("Response time < 5000 ms", () => pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(5000));

request.description:
**Stage:** copy `fixtures/tc10_invalid_total.csv` to `C:/mule-training/input/orders.csv`

**Expected HTTP:** 200 or 400

**Verify manually:** Cleansing failure, not an insert failure, so the spec is silent. Either 400 + file in `error/` + FAILED, or 200 with INV0002 in `order_errors` and INV0001 / INV0003 inserted. Agree which and tighten this assertion

**Stage:** copy `fixtures/neg01_empty.csv` to `C:/mule-training/input/orders.csv`

**Expected HTTP:** 400

**Verify manually:** 0 rows inserted; file moved to `error/`; `file_audit_log` = FAILED; nothing in `output/`

item.name: NEG02 - [Assumed] Header-only file counts as empty

request.description:
**Stage:** copy `fixtures/neg02_header_only.csv` to `C:/mule-training/input/orders.csv`

**Expected HTTP:** 400

**Verify manually:** Same as NEG01. Assumes a file with no data rows is "empty" - confirm

item.name: NEG03 - [Assumed] Whitespace-only file counts as empty

request.description:
**Stage:** copy `fixtures/neg03_whitespace_only.csv` to `C:/mule-training/input/orders.csv`

**Expected HTTP:** 400

**Verify manually:** Same as NEG01. Assumes no content after trimming is "empty" - confirm

**Stage:** copy `fixtures/neg04_5mb_plus1.csv` to `C:/mule-training/input/orders.csv`

**Expected HTTP:** 400

**Verify manually:** 5,242,881 bytes; 0 rows inserted; file moved to `error/`; FAILED

item.name: BVA01 - File 1 byte under 5 MB is accepted

request.description:
**Stage:** copy `fixtures/bva01_5mb_minus1.csv` to `C:/mule-training/input/orders.csv`

**Expected HTTP:** 200

**Verify manually:** 5,242,879 bytes; 3 rows inserted (BVM0001-0003); file in `output/`; SUCCESS

item.name: BVA02 - [Assumed] File of exactly 5 MB is accepted

request.description:
**Stage:** copy `fixtures/bva02_5mb_exact.csv` to `C:/mule-training/input/orders.csv`

**Expected HTTP:** 200

**Verify manually:** 5,242,880 bytes (5 x 1024 x 1024); only "larger than" 5 MB is rejected, so 3 rows inserted (BVE0001-0003); file in `output/`; SUCCESS. If the service uses 5,000,000 bytes this case will fail

item.name: UNK01 - No file in input folder

request.description:
**Pre-condition:** `input/` folder empty (e.g. re-send right after a successful run)

**Expected HTTP:** 4xx / 5xx

**Verify manually:** Nothing inserted or moved. Expect a 4xx/5xx with a clear message; confirm whether `file_audit_log` should record FAILED

item.name: UNK02 - Non-CSV file (.txt) in input folder

request.description:
**Stage:** copy `fixtures/unk02_not_csv.txt` to `C:/mule-training/input/orders.txt`

**Expected HTTP:** 4xx / 5xx

**Verify manually:** Spec says read a `.csv`; the .txt should not be processed. Confirm whether it goes to `error/`
